postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(name, str) for name in reindeer_names)
postconditions.description: Each name in the input list is a string.
Each name in the input list is composed of exactly two words.
The output list is sorted by the last names of the reindeer.

postconditions.expression: all(name in reindeer_names for name in sorted_reindeer_names)
postconditions.description: The output list contains all the reindeer names from the input list.
The output list is sorted by the last names of the reindeer, maintaining the original order for names with identical last names.
